title: Grill follow-ups everywhere
body:
### Summary

As a product strategist, I want follow-ups in the skill, the TUI, and the evals, so that vague criteria never reach Ready.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: a vague draft through every grill path; expected: each path asks a follow-up

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 1 criteria

### Scenario

Grill a vague story through MCP, the TUI, and the evals.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
